_about: Home-river presets. Picking a river fills in its region, water type and location. A river can also carry 'adjust': multipliers on food activity and fly scores that eval/train.py learns from its fishing reports (python -m eval.train eval/reports_tn.csv --write), with 'trained_on' recording what they were fit on. --write only keeps them for a river when they beat the plain mixed list on that river's newest reports.
